concept: A short lit arc turning in a groove: the light model at its smallest, saying something is happening while the reader waits.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a grey ring spinner with a coloured quarter (Material circular progress, the browser throbber)
default_to_avoid.why_not: a coloured arc gives the system a hue; a plain grey ring has no light

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: the ring is a groove and the arc is light travelling in it, shaded and lit like every recess

derivation.consequence: one solid fill exists, the loud solid (white in dark, ink in light); a promoted action is the same solid glowing with its own light, and a pane uses one of them
derivation.form: the arc is the loud solid, white in dark and ink in light, the one moving mark

derivation.consequence: long ease-out curves (420 to 640ms) for arriving and hovering, a shorter one (200ms) for pressing because a press is a reply; under reduced motion every duration is zero at the token level
derivation.form: it turns at one steady pace and stands still under reduced motion, where the label still says loading

options: A lit arc in a groove
variants.picked: A lit arc in a groove
variants.reason: A is the light model: a recess with light moving in it (P3). B bounces, which P4 rules out. C flashes the whole mark and reads as an alert.

root.why: the groove the arc travels in, a quiet ring recessed into the glass

sm.why: the 16px size that sits inside a button or a row of text

md.why: the 24px default size for a pane or a card that is loading

arc.why: the lit quarter in the loud solid, the one moving thing on the pane

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours draw the arc in the system text colour

@spin.why: one steady turn, zero under reduced motion at the token level
